ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Module File Created By Non-PowerShell Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a new PowerShell module ".psm1", ".psd1", ".dll", ".ps1", etc. by a non-PowerShell process

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\Modules\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\Modules\\\\.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\-preview\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\PowerShell\\\\7\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\poqexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\poqexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell\\\.exe$")))
